The remaining long path has stationary one-dependent absolute-Gaussian increments. A joint CLT with Q_n=n^(-1/2) sum (G_i^2-1), independent of G0 in the limit, has Var(A)=2-4/pi+2c, Cov(A,Q)=mu, Var(Q)=2. Spherical radial expansion subtracts mu Q/2, leaving independent Z~N(0,8/3+(4sqrt(3)-14)/pi); Slutsky covers d/sqrt(n)->beta and sqrt(n)<<d=o(n). psi(G) bounded below and unbounded above is non-Gaussian; convolution with an independent nondegenerate Gaussian is not Gaussian for beta>0. Independent implementation enumerated 325 support sign choices on small brooms and quadrature gives E psi≈0, Var psi=c=0.162751579441755. Gamma radial identity gives exact mean, old variance identity gives cross-check. Limits do not cover d/n bounded below.
